summary: Ars Technica hosts a live chat on the New Glenn catastrophe aftermath
details: Ars Technica is hosting a live chat on June 30 at 1:00 PM ET / 12:00 PM CT to discuss the aftermath of the New Glenn catastrophe and what's next for the space industry.
The live chat features Anthony Colangelo, Caleb Henry, and Eric Berger, who will share their insights and expertise on the topic.
The event will be streamed live on YouTube at youtube.com/@arstechnica.

What's next for the space industry after the New Glenn catastrophe?

Ars Technica is hosting a live chat on June 30 at 1:00 PM ET / 12:00 PM CT to discuss the aftermath of the New Glenn catastrophe and what's next for the space industry.

The live chat features Anthony Colangelo, Caleb Henry, and Eric Berger, who will share their insights and expertise on the topic.

The event will be streamed live on YouTube at youtube.com/@arstechnica.
